prompt: Write a blog post answering 'why does a strong CV get no interview callbacks?' Primary keyword: 'no interview callbacks'. Audience: recent graduates in the UK. Brand pack: evals/fixtures/brand.
expected_behaviors: Saves stages 01-08 to writers-room-output/<slug>/ and does not skip the angle or outline stage
Uses only stories S-T001 / S-T002 from the fixture story bank; quotes them verbatim
Opens with a hook, not a definition or greeting; answer block of 40-60 words near the top
Has H2s phrased as questions, a FAQ and Key takeaways
lint.py --mode blog reports 0 errors on final.md
Invents no statistic: any number not in the fixture is marked [NEEDS SOURCE]

prompt: Write a 10-minute solo podcast script on why applying to more jobs can backfire. Brand pack: evals/fixtures/brand.
expected_behaviors: Cold open in a scene from the fixture story bank, before any show intro
Every [LOOP] has a matching [CLOSE]; [REHOOK] roughly every 225 words
About 1,500 words (+/-15%)
Close calls back to the cold-open image
lint.py --mode podcast reports 0 errors on final.md
